disputes.reason: Takeaway is wrong: the 13-day weight 0.0137 is about 7% of the newest weight 0.2 (0.8^12 = 0.069), not 'about a fifth' of it. A student would learn a false decay rule.

Takeaway misstates the finance: it equates 'below the median' with -ln p > 1, but -ln p > 1 means p < 36.8%, while the median is p = 50% (-ln p = 0.69). For 36.8% < p < 50% the quantile is positive, so the rule as written is false (and contradicts the round's own 'zero at 37%' note).
